purpose: Core binary: main.go only, exits with app.Main(os.Args[1:])

Core wiring behind the binary: serve, probe, resync and recount commands; connects Mongo (MONGO_USER + SetAuth or URI credentials), NATS (publisher JetStream client with the async error handler; a separate sweeper JetStream client, 2 x SWEEP_BATCH in flight, PUB_ACK_TIMEOUT, so republishes never share the inline publisher's pending window) and two Redis instances (state: slot pool; dedupe: cid and request dedupe only) with credential and password redaction; small warm Redis pools (dedupe: 2x CID_BATCH_SHARDS + 4 conns, MinIdleConns, no command retries, 1 dial retry; both clients DisableIdentity); prepare bootstraps Mongo and ensures CHATIM_EVT and CHATIM_TIMER (no CHATIM_WORK since M3.1 Task 10); state-driven events (M3.1 Task 10): event_wiring.go builds the stateclear.Queue on Store.EventStates (STATE_CLEAR_*), the publisher with WithStateClears (no ack marks, no eventmark) and the three projection consumers room_activity, mention_reply_index (interactions, reply threads, counts, mentions, shared mentions, message count timers, publisher as event queue) and mention_read on the publisher JetStream client, their durable consumers ensured on CHATIM_EVT right after wire; drainerGroup runs and closes the projection consumers together (the first failure cancels the others); sweep_wiring.go builds the sweep.Sweeper (slot 0 leader, SWEEP_*) with sweep.NewRebuilders over the Mongo store, a pinproj.Projector and an eventkit.RoomTypes cache of 65536 rooms; no reconcile reader, effect workers or work stream consumers are built; start order publisher, state clear queue, flusher, cid batcher, router, slot manager, timer consumer, projections, sweeper, then the live watchers (member watch then room watch, after the router runs; a failed start never serves gRPC), then gRPC; stop order gRPC, sweeper (1s), projections (1s), timer consumer (1s), live watchers (Unsubscribe), router, cid batcher, flusher, publisher, state clear queue (1s, after the publisher so late PubAck clears land), slot release, admin; a drain that times out is followed by cancelling that component's Run context; metrics_wiring.go and event_metrics_wiring.go register detectors on the admin /metrics: publish_dropped_total{reason}, publish_state_track_full_total, redis_degraded{client=cid_dedupe}, cid and router counters, grpc_load_shed_total, mongo_oplog_window_seconds, state_clear_cleared/dropped/failures_total, event_pending_oldest_seconds{collection}, sweep_republished_total{collection}, sweep_dropped_total{collection}, sweep_publish_failures_total, sweep_failures_total, sweep_passes_total, projection_lag_seconds{projection}, projection_failures_total{projection}, projection_dropped_total{projection}, projection_stuck_total{projection}, counter_repaired_total{counter}, timer_failures_total, timer_dropped_total, member watch and room cache series; purpose: Permission hook: Policy (one Check method) and Checker, which always enforces tenant and membership before the policy; Checker.Admit checks tenant and membership without the policy; Checker.Allow asks the policy; Authorize does both; Request.Author and Request.Kind are the author and kind of the target message (Kind 0 for room actions); DefaultPolicy (default of NewChecker and the actor) lets only the author edit or delete and allows every other action (D86); DefaultPolicy.LockedKinds denies edit/delete of those kinds even to the author (D87); react_message, pin_message and unpin_message are allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy, also on locked kinds (D94); member and read actions add_members, remove_member, leave_room, change_member_role, set_member_priority and mark_read (MarkUnread uses mark_read); Request.Target is the target member (callers pass a stand-in with role member when the target has no doc or left) and Request.Role the wanted role; DefaultPolicy lets owner or admin add members, the owner remove anyone and an admin remove only a target with role member, only the owner change roles or set priority, anyone leave or mark read (D101); M2c actions mention_all (asked by the actor after send_message when a send carries @all), forward_message, open_direct, set_bookmark and read_replies, allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy (D114-D116); M3 send_system_message, asked by the actor for a system message with an empty Member and allowed by DefaultPolicy; MESSAGE_LOCKED_KINDS=system locks edit/delete of system messages (D87, D132); M3 update_room (owner and admin, D133) and set_room_preferences (only the Admit label of SetRoomPreferences, never asked, D127); AllowMembers allows every member; used by SendMessage in the actor; GetHistory/GetEditHistory in grpcsrv and the change commands in mutate M3 Task 11: read_reactions (GetReactions) and read_members (ListMembers), allowed to every member by DefaultPolicy.

Per-room actors behind a Router: one write group in flight; seq assignment; cid admission (pkg/lru cache then Redis); writes every entry once (never resends, requeues or re-reads; owner 2026-10-10): ErrNotSent -> ErrRetryLater at once and Abort; Duplicate/Unknown -> exactly one Find, our doc = committed, absent or Find failed -> errUnconfirmed (ErrRetryLater) keeping the cid pending and marking the actor dirty; remembers each uncertain write by (user, cid) for ReservationTTL, and a client retry of one does a single Find of its seq (own doc -> original ack + cid Commit, seq taken by another writer -> Abort, absent or Find failed -> errCIDUnsettled and kept); a PendingHere verdict marks the actor dirty; every Find (settle or retry check) gets its own budget of reservationMargin (1s) detached from the group context; answer the ack and enqueue events (best-effort) before handing the cid Commit to the registry; retire on slot move; asks the access policy before admitting a send and then mention_all when the send carries @all; SendCmd carries ReplyTo/Forward/Mentions/MentionAll and M3 Kind/SkipUnread/Meta, Router.Send normalizes it before routing (domain.ValidateReply, domain.ValidateMentions against Config.MentionTargets = MENTION_TARGETS_MAX, duplicates dropped; domain.ValidateMeta; Kind 0 = text, unknown = INVALID_ARGUMENT; domain.ValidateSystemMessage) and the actor builds the stored message from the command (SendCmd.message, no store read for links); a system message checks only the room tenant, skips membership and the member cache and asks send_system_message with an empty Member (D132); caches members per actor for memberCacheTTL 10s and drops the cache when Router.ForgetMembers bumps its generation (read before the store read); never caches not-a-member (D106); on seq contention with another write fails every uncommitted entry of the group with ErrRetryLater at once (definite ones release their cid) and yields the room through retire, never reassigning and with no backoff (D119; room_yields_total counts real yields only); counts yields and cid elsewhere

Redis cid dedupe store on the dedupe Redis instance (chatim-redis-dedupe): key chatim:cid:{room}:{user}:{cid}, or chatim:req:{room}:{user}:{request_id} for Key.Space SpaceRequest, or chatim:req:create:{tenant}:{user}:{request_id} for SpaceCreate (CreateKey: Key.Tenant, room 0; its batcher shard comes from an FNV hash of tenant:user, room keys use the slot, D118); batched Lua Reserve (pending p:{core}) / Commit (c:{seq}:{ms}; old 4-field values read as absent) / conditional Abort; degraded mode via redisguard; Batcher batches Reserve/Commit/Abort across rooms per shard (slot % CID_BATCH_SHARDS): Reserve rounds sent as soon as none is in flight (up to MaxKeys), Commit/Abort queued without blocking and flushed on Close; Requests dedupes commands by request_id over any Registry (the Batcher in prod): Begin maps Reserve to RequestNew/RequestDone/RequestBusy and returns the committed Record when done (Redis errors fall back to a RAM LRU of RequestCacheSize records valid until ttl after the command), Finish = Commit + remember, Cancel = Abort

Pending-state clear queue (M3.1): Add(store.StateTarget) never blocks; a full buffer (STATE_CLEAR_QUEUE 65536) or Add after Close drops and counts the target (full queue logged at most once per second); one Run goroutine flushes when STATE_CLEAR_BATCH (500) targets are buffered or STATE_CLEAR_FLUSH (100ms) after the first target of a batch (timer armed per batch, idle = no wakeups); each flush is one Clearer.Clear with a constant 1s timeout (ClearTimeout); a failed Clear is counted per target and logged at most once per second, never retried (the slot-0 sweeper republishes); Close(ctx) closes the buffer, lets Run flush the rest within DrainTimeout 1s (or ctx), then cancels the in-flight Clear and counts what is left as dropped; Cleared/Dropped/Failures count targets (sum = targets added)

Pending-event sweeper (M3.1 Task 9a and 9b, D146-D149, D154; wired by app since Task 10 on its own JetStream client): Run checks Owns(LeaderSlot 0) every Tick (SLOT_TICK) and, while leading, runs one pass over the collections that have a Rebuilder every Interval (SWEEP_INTERVAL 2s), logging event sweeper started when a lead starts and event sweeper lost the leader slot when it ends (the oldest gauges reset); one collection: from = 0 on the first pass of a lead (or after the probe found a stuck doc), else checkpoint - Lookback (SWEEP_LOOKBACK 30s), before = now - MinAge (SWEEP_MIN_AGE 5s); pages of Batch (SWEEP_BATCH 500) by EventStates.Pending; per doc and set bit the Rebuilder builds events from the current doc; Gone errors (eventkit.Gone) clear the bit at the version the rebuilder read (dropWith) or, for a bit whose version is in the key (messages/rooms bit 1, edits, pins, hidden), the doc key and count dropped; a versioned bit with no read version is a failure and keeps its flag; bits outside the collection warn once per doc key and never put the collection in first-pass mode; Close is checked before each collection; after the PubAck deadline every future is read once more without blocking so earlier acks still clear; other errors keep the flag and count a failure; a token bucket (Rate = SWEEP_RATE 5000/s, burst and start = min(Batch, Rate), no busy wait) paces each page; the page is published with PublishMsgAsync and its PubAcks awaited within AckTimeout (PUB_ACK_TIMEOUT); every acked event clears its publish.StateTargetOf target in one Clear; a refused publish, failed or late PubAck or failed Clear keeps the flag; the new checkpoint (SweepCheckpoints.Advance) = the oldest StateAt still flagged by a failure of this pass, else before; losing slot 0 or Close stops after the current page without advancing; after each collection a probe Pending(0, new checkpoint - Lookback, limit 1) puts the collection back in first-pass mode when it finds a doc, raises its oldest gauge and warns pending state older than the sweep checkpoint (once per second, also for such docs on a first pass); NewMessageRebuilder (bit 1 msg_created, bit 2 counts_changed reactions, bit 4 counts_changed replies, from one Find and the cached room type) and NewRoomRebuilder (bit 1 room_created, bit 2 member_count_changed, bit 4 room_updated, from Rooms.Get); a zero counter version drops; Task 9b: NewEditRebuilder (Edits.At fact, ApplyEdit (only where v < ver) and PurgeText below a delete fact, Find, a projection still behind the fact keeps the flag, pbconv.MessageChanged at the fact version), NewInteractionRebuilder (GetReaction/GetBookmark of the current doc, reaction_changed/bookmark_changed at its current ver, so a doc changed again keeps its newer flag), NewPinRebuilder (pinproj Project up to pin_ver = PendingDoc.Seq, a lost CAS keeps the flag, Pins.At + Find, pbconv.PinChanged, no text when deleted), NewMemberRebuilder (one MembersOf; bit 1 pbconv.MemberEvent (none = drop at ver), bit 2 read_updated, bit 4 history_cleared of the current cleared_at (never cleared = drop), bit 8 room_preferences_changed; room identity from eventkit.RoomTypes; a gone room drops at the current versions), NewHiddenRebuilder (Hidden.Get, message_hidden at the hide time); a vanished reaction, bookmark, hide or pin fact is errDocGone (classified Gone through apperr.ErrInvalidArgument) and drops; NewRebuilders(RebuilderStores, room types, now) builds the map of all seven collections for Deps.Rebuilders (every store required); accessors PendingOldest(collection) (oldest of the first page and the probe), Republished(collection) (non-duplicate PubAcks), Dropped(collection), PublishFailures, Failures (rebuild and clear), Passes

purpose: Not wired since M3.1 Task 10 (removed in Task 11). Effect engine workers: one goroutine per work partition that fetches only while this core owns the slot with the same number (checked before every fetch); groups a batch by change kind and runs the kind's effects in registry order, each after max(CommittedAt) + its delay; acks a record when every effect returned nil, else naks it after WORK_RETRY_DELAY; Close stops fetching, lets a running effect finish and hands records still waiting their delay back with Nak(0); undecodable and deferred unknown-kind records count as failures; Stats (processed, failed, lag behind commit + delay); msg_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY): batch ack mark lookup (failure = all unmarked), majority Find of unmarked messages per room, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for every PubAck; missing doc, unknown room or invalid key is dropped and counted; room type cache (eventkit.RoomTypes) shared across partitions; room_created effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Rooms.Get, event rebuilt with pbconv.RoomCreated (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; unknown room dropped and counted; room_activity uses seq 0 for every kind except MessageInserted (edits, reactions and pins bump only the change time and bucket, kept apart from new messages of the same timeline); edit_projection effect (delay 0) for EditInserted (a ver 0 original row returns nil at once): Edits.At, Messages.ApplyEdit (CAS by version), PurgeText below a delete fact; missing fact dropped and counted; msg_changed effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark; skips a ver 0 record without reading): Edits.At, room type cache, Find, refuses (retry) while the projection is behind the fact, event rebuilt with pbconv.MessageChanged (fast path parity), publish and wait for the PubAck; counts as republished only PubAcks the stream had not deduplicated; missing fact, message or room dropped; count_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, D113) for ReactionChanged: groups the batch by message, one Find per message, publishes counts_changed {room}-{thread}-{seq}-reactions-v{v} of the current rx when v >= 1 (the stream drops the fast-path copy by id), counts only PubAcks the stream had not stored; missing message or room dropped, store errors retry every record of the message; reaction_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Reactions.Get, publishes reaction_changed only when the doc change number equals the record (newer doc skips, older doc = ErrStaleRead retry), missing doc or room dropped; pin_projection effect (delay 0) for PinInserted: one pinproj Project per room up to the newest pin version of the batch, missing room dropped, other errors retry every record of the room; pin_event effect (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark): Pins.At(room, pv), Find, pbconv.PinChanged (deleted message without text); missing fact, message or room dropped; eventPublisher shares the publish loop, room type cache and counters of the new event effects; groupRecords groups record indexes by key; member effects (memberEffect shares setup, current doc lookup and drop rules): member_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) MembersOf(room,[user]) publishes pbconv.MemberEvent only when the doc ver equals the record (newer doc skips, older = ErrStaleRead retry, nil event = nothing), missing doc or room dropped; member_count_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) one Rooms.Get per room per batch, publishes member_count_changed of the stored count when member_count_ver >= 1 (actor empty), missing room drops every record of the room; mention_read (delay 0, before read_event) for ReadChanged reads the members' current docs (one MembersOf per room), drops a missing member, Naks with ErrStaleRead when read_ver is behind the record, else one MentionReads.MarkRead(room, user, read_seq) per (room, user); read_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for ReadChanged republishes read_updated when read_ver equals the record; hidden_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for MessageHidden reads Hidden.Get and publishes message_hidden at the hide time, missing hide dropped; history_cleared_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY) for HistoryCleared publishes history_cleared of the current cleared_at, never cleared or missing member dropped; room type cache also keeps the room tenant (identity) for events built from a room; bookmark_event (BookmarkEvent, delay RECONCILE_DELAY, no ack mark) for BookmarkChanged after room_activity: GetBookmark, publishes bookmark_changed (pbconv.BookmarkChanged, fast path parity) only when the doc ver equals the record (newer doc skips, older = ErrStaleRead retry), missing doc or room dropped; reply_mention_index effect (delay 0, D114, D115) for MessageInserted and EditInserted: only records with flags (MessageInserted Version = ReplyMentionFlags) or an edit ver >= 1 are read, one Find per room per batch; reply (insert record with HasReply, or edit record of a deleted message with reply_to): ArmMessageCountCheck(parent, replies) -> AddReply (live message) or RemoveReply (deleted) -> only on a real change AddReplyCount(+1/-1) -> counts_changed {room}-{thread}-{seq}-replies-v{v} (PubAck awaited) -> Disarm; no change = Disarm only; a count or publish failure keeps the timer and Naks; a vanished parent or room is dropped and disarmed; mentions (insert record with HasMention, every edit record): Mentions.ApplyMentions of the current message (targets from MentionTargetsOf, none when deleted) at messages.v, then SharedMentionRaiser.RaiseSharedMention(room, message created_at) when the targets hold @all or a group (rooms.last_shared_mention_at $max; a delete never lowers it; raise error Naks); missing message dropped; errors per record Nak; eventPublisher.publishOne M3 Task 6: room_activity sets Activity.Edited for EditInserted on thread 0 (kept apart from reactions and other seq-0 kinds, so only edits raise last_edit_at) and keeps Seq 0 for RoomChanged/PreferenceChanged; RoomEvent room_event (delay RECONCILE_DELAY, Rooms.Get, publishes room_updated when info_ver equals the record, newer = skip, older = ErrStaleRead Nak, missing room dropped, counts only non-duplicate PubAcks); PreferencesEvent preferences_event (same with MembersOf and preference_ver, room_preferences_changed with the full state); reply_mention_index calls ReplyThreadWriter.Touch(parent, tenant, reply seq, sent time) for every live reply record after the count timer is disarmed (also when AddReply found the doc), a failure Naks, a deleted reply never touches. M3.1 Task 7: member_count_repair and count_repair moved to event/timer; reply_mention_index arms timer.Timers (LinkTimers returns timer.Timer).

Shared helpers of the event flow, kept apart so deleting effects (M3.1) does not drag them along: RoomTypes caches room identity (id, tenant, type) by room id up to a limit (cleared whole at the limit, misses not cached); LimitedLog warns at most once per second; MessageKey builds store.MsgKey from room, thread and seq; Undeliverable (missing room, invalid argument) and Gone (also missing edit, message or member) classify errors that drop a record; NakDelay(numDelivered) gives the Nak ladder 5s, 30s, 2m, 10m then 10m (delivery 0 counts as 1); NewPullSource(js, stream, consumer) fetches up to a limit from a durable JetStream pull consumer (looked up once, lazily; a fetch that only waited out its wait is not an error) as Delivery (Data, Delivered = NumDelivered, Ack, Nak(delay), Term)

Room/Member/Message types and validation; message kind names from one table (ParseKind: text, system; unknown -> ErrInvalidArgument); Message edit state (Version/Deleted/EditedAt) and view-only Hidden; Edit row (EditText/EditDelete, EditOriginal only at version 0 = the content at send time; one text per row, no Prev); Member.ClearedAt (zero = never cleared, D97); HiddenMessage (user, room, thread, seq, hide time);
